# reverse

## Description

Reverse video file

## Arguments

- *(No additional program-specific arguments; uses global videobeaux options only.)*

## Program Template

```bash
videobeaux -P reverse -i input.mp4 -o output.mp4
```

## Real World Example

```bash
videobeaux -P reverse -i myvideo.mp4 -o reverse_styled.mp4
```
